findings.detail: The R10 contract creates src/jarvis_foundry/command_center/ as an additive package. Python resolves the package before the sibling command_center.py module, so the package __init__ loads the legacy module under a private alias and re-exports build_snapshot, decision_timeline, and CommandCenterServer. tests/foundry and briefings.py keep the exact same public API without editing the legacy module.
findings.title: Command Center package shadows the legacy command_center.py module

findings.detail: The probe invokes System.Speech directly. If no recognizer/voice receipt is produced the classification is NOT_TESTED (or TTS_ONLY when only real TTS succeeds); mock STT/TTS is never presented as real voice proof.
findings.title: Voice is honestly classified by a real local SAPI probe

findings.detail: Playwright and axe are not installed and network is disabled, so screenshots and DOM dumps use the installed Chrome/Edge headless binary and the page runs a real in-page DOM accessibility audit (landmarks, labels, unique ids, button names). The toolchain status is recorded honestly.
findings.title: Visual evidence uses real Chrome headless; axe is unavailable

findings.detail: R10-G01..G06 reproduce the required evidence, but the final builder_status stays NOT_TESTED until a fresh independent verifier reproduces every criterion from the frozen package.
findings.title: Builder status remains NOT_TESTED until fresh independent adjudication

findings.detail: Cosmetic: R10_FULL_SUITE_RAW.txt may omit final 'N passed' lines; JUnit counts and exit codes are authoritative.
findings.title: Full-suite raw outputs may omit pytest summary lines

findings.detail: R10_STATE_SNAPSHOT.json is the full isolated-proving projection so a verifier can reproduce drill-down and timeline checks without re-running the seeder; it stays inside the 8 MiB evidence budget.
findings.title: Evidence snapshot carries the full durable projection

findings.detail: R10_PROGRESS_04.json existed in the evidence dir but was absent from the artifact manifest, so evidence_bytes did not equal the on-disk total and the closed package was not byte-identical to the manifest. Progress checkpoints are incremental working artifacts, not closure evidence; evidence_bytes() and the manifest scan now exclude R10_PROGRESS_*.json, and the regenerated manifest matches the on-disk payload byte-for-byte.
findings.title: Incremental progress file excluded from the frozen manifest

findings.detail: The SQ briefing body sentences ('Keep the R10 builder evidence package closed', 'Measured USD total is', 'accepted missions, ...') were English under Albanian labels; gates and tests only asserted labels/titles. The briefing generator now emits genuinely localized per-language body text for every category (data values such as record titles remain in their source language), and the G03/G04 gates plus regression tests assert no English template fragments appear in the SQ body.
findings.title: Albanian briefing/page body contained English template sentences

findings.detail: live_guard.py compare read provenance['r10_attributable_mutation'] even when _live_db_provenance returned testable=False (snapshot missing), raising KeyError instead of recording an honest FAIL. The provenance now always includes r10_attributable_mutation (True when untestable, fail-closed), and a clean before/after/compare run now records protected_state_unchanged=True with r10_attributable_mutation=False.
findings.title: Live-guard compare did not fail closed on a missing DB snapshot
